Name: Indoor Orchard
Author: Syanide23
Description:
This greenhouse-style building is designed specifically for growing fruit trees, providing a space to cultivate up to 35 trees in any season. It can be built by Robin and will visually match any greenhouse replacer if applied through Content Patcher. Unlike the standard greenhouse, this building can be constructed before unlocking the greenhouse, allowing for early orchard development.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8992]Better Junimos Forestry[/url]!
